# Where to find Robot Models in Fallout 76

Co-written by Lesley and Jessicca.

With thanks to Trashy.

__Used For:__

- Epic Weekly Challenge - Collect 3 Complete Robot Models
 - Robot Models that count towards the Challenge
 - Mr Handy Model
 - Mr Gutsy Model
 - Eyebot Model
 - Sentry Bot Model
 - Protection Model
 - Note: the mixed Robot Models do not count towards the challenge.

__Types__

There are 8 Robots to collect:

Eyebot Model - Counts toward the Epic Challenge

Mr. Gutsy Model - Counts toward the Epic Challenge

Mr. Handy Model - Counts toward the Epic Challenge

Protectron Model - Counts towards the Epic Challenge

Sentry Bot Model - Counts towards the Epic Challenge

Robot Parts Model A (01) - Does not count towards the Epic Challenge

Robot Parts Model B (02) - Does not count towards the Epic Challenge

Robot Parts Model C (03) - Does not count towards the Epic Challenge

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

Robot Models are a per-server, pick-up history, world spawn item.

This means they will only spawn once per location per server. If another player collects it before you, you won’t be able to collect it on the same server. If the Robot Models isn’t there for you and you haven’t collected it from that location before, try server hopping or switching to a private server to look again.

However, if you’ve already collected a Robot Model from that location and it isn’t there when you return, you’ll need to refresh your pick-up history list before it can respawn for you.

If you’re still unsure or would like more details, check out my __How Spawns Work in Fallout 76__ guide, which you can find here.

Avoid using grenades and explosive weapons as the Robot Models can move.

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

__Ash Heap__

**Lewisburg - Van Lowe Taxidermy**

1x Robot Parts Model B (02)

From the fast travel point, take the road on your left and follow it until you reach the first street on your right. Van Lowe Taxidermy is on the corner of the first street.

Enter the building and turn left. Go through the door marked "Employees Only" and take the stairs to the top. Head into the kitchen and turn left. Walk to the end of the room and take the stairs up to the top again. At the top of the stairs turn right and walk over to the broken door.

The Robot Parts Model B (02) is on the desk, next to the terminal, in the middle of the room.

__Forest__

**Vault 51**

2x Eyebot Models

1x Mr Handy Model

1x Sentry Bot Model

To enter Vault 51 you will need to unlock the door. To do this, enter the truck trailer on your left and push the button on the wall at the end.

Collecting the robot models here will be made easier if you collect all the keycards first so you can access all the rooms. Directions to all the keycards can be found __here.__

Enter the vault and go through screening, turn right under the Welcome to Vault 51 banner. Go past the front desk, into the Atrium, and head upstairs. Turn left and go through the wide opening into a sitting room. Turn right into the bedroom, and on the desk is an Eyebot Model.

For the next one, you will need to have completed the unmarked quest inside Vault 51 and obtained all the keycards to gain access to the Overseer's Office. Some lock-picking cards or Master Infiltrator won't go a miss here either.

Retrieve the overseer's key card and head up to the Overseer's Office.

The Overseer's Office can be found in the Atrium, on the second floor, in the North corner.

Follow the stairs up to the top and you will see a semi-circle desk with a window behind it. On the desk are a Mr. Handy model and an Eyebot model

Stand with your back to the Overseer's desk and face East. Head to the door on the left. Unlock it and walk inside the room. The Sentry Bot Model will be on the desk on your right as you enter the room.

**Tyler County Dirt Track**

1x Mr Handy Model

Fast travel to Tyler County Fairgrounds and follow northwest, then turn left onto the connecting road.

You will see a dirty white building with bleachers facing the track

Proceed to the stairs at the back and take them up to the second floor. Go through the door, and walk down the hall to another door. The Mr. Handy model will be on the middle desk.

**Settler's Ridge**

1x Mr Handy Model

**Fraternity Row - ETA PSI House**

Note these are only chess pieces and do not count towards the challenge, however, they can still be displayed.

From the spawn-in location, turn left and follow the road up until you see a building on your right with a blue door.

Enter via the Blue door and head upstairs. At the top of the stairs, turn right and then turn right again. The Robot Model chess pieces are on the table, in the corner.

**Overseer's Home**

1x Eyebot Model

1x Mr Handy Model

In the display cases on the second floor. Can not be accessed.

**Summersville - Duncan & Duncan Robotics**

Duncan & Duncan Robotics is an instanced location which means that it is not affected by per server spawn rules.

1x Protectron Model

1x Mr Handy Model

1x Eyebot Model

1x Sentry Bot Model

From the fast travel point, follow the road towards the town center. Duncan and Duncan is on the south side of the main road through Summersville, between the Delicatessen and the clothing store (the door is easy to miss, it looks like a boarded building).

A key card is required for entry (from the __Strength In Numbers__ quest).

From the front desk, turn left and enter the level 0 locked door. Inside the room, on a table, on the left side of the room is a Protectron Model.

Turn around and walk back to the front desk. Face the desk and then turn and walk through the door on your right. Stop in the middle of the doorway and on your left, on the black table is a Mr Handy Model.

From the room with the Mr Handy Model, walk over to the counter on the West side of the room. You will see a robot named Skinner. Behind Skinner is a set of stairs. Either jump the counter or use the door on the right to get to the stairs and follow them to the top.

At the top of the stairs is a level 1 locked door. Unlock the door and stop in the middle of the doorway. On your left, on the desk, is the Eyebot Model.

From the Eyebot Model, face East and walk to the end of the room. Turn right and stop at the red chair on your left. The Sentry Bot Model is on the table in front of you.

**Summersville Dam**

1x Protectron Model

From the spawn in location, look to your right. You will see a pile of boats stacked on top of each other. Head over to those boats and use them to climb to the top of the cliff. Check the white boat at the bottom as sometimes Sugar Bombs with rads can spawn in the yellow box.

At the top of the cliff, face NW and you will see some large blue pipes and a building. Walk over and enter the building. You will see the Protectron Model on top of a broken terminal.

__Toxic Valley__

No spawns

__Savage Divide__

**Foundation - Foundation Supply Room**

1x Eyebot Model

1x Mr Handy Model

1x Protectron Model

In the display case in the Foundation Supply Room. Can not be accessed.

__Skyline Valley__

**Atrium Upper Level**

1x Mr Handy Model

Chess Pieces

**Rapidan Camp**

External

1x Robot Parts Model

**The Brown House**

**Internal**

Note these are only chess pieces and do not count towards the challenge, however, they can still be displayed.

__The Mire__

**Freddy Fear's House of Scares**

Note you will need to have completed the TNT Dome #2 mini-quest to access this location. A full guide can be found __here__.

1x Mr Handy Model

From the fast travel point, turn and face North. Walk down the right-hand side of the building until you see a set of stairs.

Walk up the stairs until you get to the top. Walk forward a bit until you see a red door on your right-hand side and use the Rusted Key to open the door.

Stop just inside the door and look straight ahead. You will see the Mr Handy on the shelf in front of you.

**The Retreat**

1x Robot Parts Model A (01)

1x Robot Parts Model B (02)

1x Robot Parts Model C (03)

From the spawn-in point, turn slightly to your left until you are facing the medium industrial water purifier as marked in the photo below.

Run over and stand behind the water purifier and face West. You will see a set of stairs in front of you, on the other side of the water. Take the stairs to the top, walk along the wooden bridge, and open the red door.

On the bookcase at the back of the room, you can find the Robot Parts Model B (02) and Robot Parts Model C (03).

Turn around and face the bed in the North corner of the room. The Robot Parts Model A (01) is on a wooden crate next to the bed.

__Cranberry Bog__

**RobCo Research Center**

Robco is an instanced location which means that it is not affected by per server spawn rules.

1x Eyebot Model

1x Sentry Bot Model

1x Protectron Model

1x Mr. Handy Model

1x Mr. Gutsy Model

1x Robot Model Parts A (01)

1x Robot Model Parts B (02)

1x Robot Model Parts C (03)

From the fast travel point, run up the hill and jump over the green truck trailer. Keep running towards the building in front of you and enter through the main doors on your left.

From inside the front door, walk forward, past the reception desks, and enter the elevator in front of you. Take the elevator down to the basement and step out into the room. In front of you is a window and a metal door with some buttons on the wall. Walk over to the mental door and use the button on the wall to open it. Enter the room and in front of you, on the corner of the black console is the Robot Parts Model C (03).

Before you go back up the elevator, look for the level 1 wall terminal in the Northern corner of the basement. You can turn off all the turrets in the building from here. Once you have done that, go back up the elevator.

Leave the elevator and stop at the end of the black couch on your left. Turn left and enter the door marked "Facilities Wing".

You will need to have finished the __Mayor for a Day__ questline to access the next robot model.

Walk through the door and turn right. Follow the white wall around until you get to a door with an ID card reader on your right. Swipe the keycard and enter the room. The Mr. Gutsy Model will be on top of the filing cabinet at the South end of the room.

Exit the room and face NE. Follow the path to the double doors at the end of the floor. Inside the room, on the desk is an Eyebot Model and a Sentry Bot Model.

Leave the room above and face West. You will see a set of stairs on your left and a door to an office on your right. Enter the door on your right and the Eyebot Model is on top of the filing cabinet in the NE corner of the room.

Leave the room above and face East. Walk up the set of stairs in front of you and turn left. Walk to the end and enter the door/office on your left. The Mr Handy Model is in the Southern corner of the office, on the bottom shelf of the coffee stand.

Exit the room and face West. You will see a Protectron station and the door to another office.

Walk over to the office and enter the room. Jump down the hole in the floor and then down through the second hole in the floor. Turn SE and look for the desk with the broken terminal. The Protectron Model is on the desk, laying down and slightly hidden by the metal tray on the right-hand side.

Turn NW and walk forward until you get to the double door on your right. Turn right (NE) and you will see two doors in front of you marked as Male and Female bathrooms. Walk over and enter the Female bathroom (door on the right).

The Robot Parts Model A (01) is in the toilet in the third stall from the right.

Exit the bathroom and face West. Walk up the stairs in front of you and enter the Research Labs. Walk along the left-hand side until you see a glass wall and some turrets on your left. The Robot Parts Model B (02) is on the corner of the bench, next to some black consoles.

**Pylon V-13 - Abandoned Bog Town**

1x Protectron Model

From Pylon V-13, face West and run over to the large building in front of you. You might want to dispose of the Super Mutants first.

At the back of the large building, turn North and walk forward until you get to the back of the diner. Jump on top of the diner and face West.

In front of you will be a road and then a house. To the left of the house is a road heading West.

Run over and follow the road to the end, turn left, and then turn right. Walk down the road and on your right will be a shed.

Enter the shed and the Protectron Model will be inside the trailer, on the desk, next to the terminal.

**Watoga - AMS Headquarters**

Note: There are turrets here and lots of them. It is suggested that you run ahead a destroy all of the turrets and then come back and follow the below directions.

1x Eyebot Model

1x Protectron Model

1x Mr Handy Model

You will spawn directly in front of an elevator.

Take the elevator to the AMS Headquarters. Exit the elevator, walk up the small set of stairs, and then turn right. Keep following the wall around until you see access tube number 3 and then take the access tube to the third floor.

Go across the room to the double doors on the south side of the room, turn right, make a left at the end of the hall, and go up the stairs.

When you get to the next fork (two floors up), turn left, then right at the end of the hallway. Go up the short flight of stairs, then follow the balcony around and go up the next short flight of stairs.

Go up the red stairs in the following room, go left, then up the next set of red stairs, and the next set of white stairs.

Turn left, then go to the west side of this floor, and open the door. On the bottom of this shelf is an Eyebot Model, Protectron model, and Mr. Handy model.

**Big Bend Tunnel East**

1x Robot Parts Model

From the spawn in location, turn around and face East. Walk forward and jump on top of the train carriage. Take a few steps forward, turn right, and jump down to the ground. Turn NE and enter the train carriage. Face East and walk forward until you get to the bookcase at the end. The Robot Parts Model is on the bottom shelf of the bookcase.

__Checklists__

**Your progress will be automatically saved as you mark the boxes on the checklist below**
